early_stop: run all 80; minimum inner EMA over 10..80; no outer-based extension
budget_extension: only if ALL core arms have boundary selection and negative final10 EMA slope in ALL cells, extend ALL core arms to120 with new version before outer evaluation; otherwise flag affected cells
sampling: coordinate lexsort widest-interval midpoint prefix; nested; outcome blind
loss: full-partition Efron; checkpoint chunks only encode, concatenate all risks before ONE loss
clinical: six legal fields; field-local train-coded tokens; D2 AGE/SEX/Stage
anchor: train-only Clinical+S32 Ridge initialization then JOINTLY optimized; no fixed risk stacking
rna: train90percent observed then Top512 variance; shared identical genes all C arms
RNA_token_budget: 8x512x64 registered weights; ordered supports8x64; true Hallmark membership on Top512 with explicit uncovered fallback; random permutation preserves ALL overlaps and sizes
C2: patient-gated gene soft weights, same full gene-projection tensor; gate extra active params disclosed

bootstrap.scheme: shared patient multinomial counts, same all arms/seeds; within-fold pairs only

probe: RNA-only frozen raw-token and processed-token mean,64D and trainPCA16 sensitivity; lambda selected from selected-inner model heldout representations; scaler/PCA train-only
clinical_min_sensitivity: D2 only; no outcome-containing clinical text
decision: SUPPORTED_INTERNAL only both primary metric simultaneous lower>0 and all3 seed deltas>0 plus controls/no invalidity; otherwise directional/inconclusive/config-not-supported
privacy: patient IDs, OOF, checkpoints, per-patient/slide manifests private; public aggregate only
CNA: not run; exploratory optional branch excluded from this RNA main matrix
